lounges.name: Philippine Airlines Mabuhay Lounge (T1)
lounges.location: Terminal 1 international departures; follow Mabuhay Lounge signs after security.

hours.note: PAL publishes a weekly Wednesday closure as “2400H–0200H”, but does not give a complete opening schedule. Confirm the affected overnight window before relying on this lounge.

accessRules.label: Philippine Airlines international Business Class
conditions: Present a same-day boarding pass. Confirm PAL’s published 2–3 hour pre-departure allowance and Wednesday overnight closure for your visit.

sources.title: Philippine Airlines · international lounges and Mabuhay house rules

lounges.note: This is the newer international T1 lounge, not the old T2 international lounge. PAL’s 2–3 hour wording is represented conservatively as a two-hour stay. Mabuhay Miles tiers are not yet selectable; oneworld status alone is not treated as access. Amenities await current operator confirmation.

qualityRating.summary: A July 2025 visit found a comfortable modern space with useful showers and a reasonable Filipino buffet. Wear in the relaxation area, limited privacy and morning dining crowds kept it below leading regional lounges.

lounges.name: PAGSS Premium Lounge (T1)
lounges.location: Airside, East Concourse, next to Gate 2.
lounges.note: Separate from PAGSS locations in T3 and the T1 observation level. Priority Pass lists a 01:30–02:30 closure on Mondays and Thursdays. Showers and quiet facilities are unconfirmed.

qualityRating.summary: A July 2026 firsthand account of the Gate 2 lounge found dated, cramped seating and disappointing food. Its main advantage was a convenient place for a drink before boarding.

sources.title: Fly for Points · PAGSS Premium Terminal 1 (July 2026)
